[[Princess/Legends|Princess]] '''Aereena''' was the daughter of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Alarik X]] and [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Careese]], rulers of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lazerian IV]]. She saw the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as a manipulative entity, and sought to combat its influence on her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] by leading the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] resistance on the planet. Few of the resistance members knew who led them, and in public she played the part of the spoiled princess.
